column4: The dependent explains charge formation and mobile ions in supplied NaCl/MgCl2 solution data. It does not require the whole comparison of metallic solids, salt melts and molecular liquids assessed by the prerequisite; particle-level ionic mobility is the narrower necessary component.

Both biodiesel cases require triglyceride structure and mixture identity, separation of direct oil use from methyl esters, motor suitability and origin-dependent environmental limits. Those are the oil competence itself; transesterification is the added dependent operation.

The quantitative profile explicitly requires proportional charge-to-amount reasoning, different electron numbers, separation of amount and mass, and current-efficiency boundaries, including a separate qualitative case. These are exactly the two qualitative Faraday relationships, not merely a convenient calculation route.

The prerequisite includes oxidation-number-independent redox half-equations, electron cancellation and acidic/metal redox transfer. Acid/base titration requires atom-balanced neutralisation and reaction factors but no electron-transfer half-equation competence; only that narrower stoichiometry is necessary.

All conductivity cases supply the observations and solution concentrations. Successful interpretation needs no weighing, transfer, stirring, labelling or performed preparation/simulator log, which are the prerequisite's actual assessed actions.

The chromatographic tasks start from supplied samples, standards and approved mobile phases. Applying small sample spots and developing a chromatogram does not necessarily require independently preparing a homogeneous solution and its preparation log.
The acid/neutral/base cases expressly supply teacher observations and indicator colour cards. Classifying those data needs no self-made homogeneous solution or preparation log.

The dependent requires actual supervised titration with handling, addition and documentation. Correct eye protection, clear labelled workspace and stopping for an unclear vessel or splash are necessary parts of that safe practical performance; paper calculation alone cannot stand for the dependent's whole performance.

The dependent receives standard reduction potentials and asks for reference conventions, redox direction, equations and cell voltage. It does not require deriving an empirical metal order from displacement observations and cell measurements first.

Both electrophilic-addition cases concern alkene plus HBr with stated ionic conditions. Comparing alkane radical halogen substitution with alkene Br2 addition is a separate competence; the subsequent plastics endpoint also cannot make it necessary.

The CuO/FeS cases supply all masses including excess residue and ask for a constant elemental product ratio. They do not require analysing open gas-loss versus closed-system weighing; that full conservation competence is a possible explanatory route rather than a necessary prior performance.

The titration profile requires independently developing analytical amount/volume references, distinguishing aliquot amounts from concentration, and deriving 1:1 versus 1:2 stoichiometry. Meaningful use of mol for named entities and constituent ratios is necessary to do this rather than only substitute numbers.

The dependent interprets a condition-specific molar gas volume and compares different ideal gases and changed pressure. The Avogadro relation between equal V at equal T,p and equal particle amount is necessary to justify that common molar-volume model and its limits.

Corrosion cases require local oxidation/reduction equations and charge pathways. The full prerequisite additionally derives arbitrary aqueous redox equations via oxidation numbers and acidic permanganate/H+ balancing. These extra operations are unnecessary for the given neutral oxygen-corrosion and sacrificial-anode cases.

The social plastics tasks explain supplied PP/composite function and compare material, cost and lifetime data. Deriving PE/PA/styrene repeat motifs, polymerisation and covalent networking from monomer functionality is not necessary to make those judgments.

The dependent uses stated HCl, NaOH and Ca(OH)2 identities and dissociation conditions. Recalling all five acid and four hydroxide names/formulas and their solution names, including weak-acid boundaries, is not required for the actual strong-solution calculations and preparations.

The dependent decides new substance versus unchanged substance from explicit before/after analyses. The complete state-transition competence includes sublimation/deposition and boiling versus evaporation, which neither dependent case requires; gas bubbles alone are expressly insufficient.

The CFC and HFC tasks require checking author, date, purpose, advertising claim, competing evidence and claim-specific limits. Comparing relevance, trustworthiness and validity of sources is necessary to the dependent's explicitly source-critical judgment.

Polymer-class tasks receive chain/network structures and mechanical/thermal behaviour. Explaining thermoplastic/elastomer/thermoset structure and uses does not need an HX electrophilic-addition mechanism, carbocation or electron arrows.

The introductory safety task is performed before any chemical material handling, at a water-only station. Mastery of weighing, pipetting, filtration, decantation, purity limits and raw laboratory protocols is not a prerequisite for checking goggles, labels and an unclear vessel; requiring it reverses sensible safety preparation.

The ASS extraction dependent is explicitly a planning and supplied-data comparison problem. The prerequisite's actual self-planned qualitative AND quantitative hypothesis investigations and own executed logs are unnecessary to plan solvent/trennung steps or interpret the supplied TLC and melting data.

Salt dissolution needs signs of existing cations/anions, hydration orientation and lattice/hydration energy. It does not require demonstrating formation of atomic ions from electron transfer or their migration to electrodes, which belong to the full prerequisite.

The dependent must derive criteria, produce evidence-grounded chances/risks for options, weigh them with an explicit strategy and revise the decision under changed conditions. Finding and weighting one's own pro/con arguments against a supplied claim is necessary to those whole decision tasks.

Protein-product tasks require own sourced ecological, economic and ethical arguments, equivalent protein/function bases, a counter-source and explicit weighting. The prerequisite's independently generated and weighed pro/con arguments are the necessary reasoning operation, rather than optional background.

The coordinate-bond task supplies donor and acceptor orbitals and asks for electron-pair donation to Cu2+. Full metallic, ionic and covalent bonding comparison, conductivity of metal/solid/melt and the CuCl2 counterexample are not needed; covalent pair concepts are only a proper subset.

Molecular-polarity tasks use supplied EN, geometry and legends. They need polar covalent bonds and vector cancellation but not metallic bonding, ionic solids/melts or their conductivity, all required by the whole prerequisite.

Photometry requires judging blank, calibration range, nonlinearity, reference-control bias and the distinction between repeatability and accuracy. Claim-specific adequacy, confounds and bounded data conclusions are necessary to deciding whether a computed concentration may be released.

Both purity-content cases require selecting a selective method, assessing blanks/repeats/drying, and rejecting nonselective mass loss or an interfering soluble component. Assessing adequacy, possible procedural errors and the limits of chemical data is directly necessary to the dependent's reliability judgment.

The dependent evaluates a particular splash or inhalation exposure and develops measures that reduce that same route. Justifying protection from substance hazard plus activity/exposure conditions is the necessary operation; a hazard symbol alone cannot do the job.

The dependent gives controlled qualitative collision comparisons and explicitly rejects a universal quantitative rate law. Determining tangent/secant rates, stoichiometric rate normalisation and gas-volume-to-amount conversion is unnecessary for those explanations.

Carboxyl-group identification, acid observations and writing a homologous series from given structures do not require the alcohol oxidation pathways to aldehydes, ketones and acids; that synthesis route is one possible context only.

The ordering task uses supplied ionic/metal/molecular data and one ethanol/ether boiling comparison. The prerequisite additionally requires solvent selection and positive melting/packing explanations for isomers. Those whole additional competences are not needed for the actual ordering tasks.

The critical-source tasks ask relevance, author/intention, method and bounded validity of supplied materials. The full prerequisite additionally requires producing an audience-adapted structured information product with source citation and transfer to another audience; a valid source judgment can be completed without that communication performance.

The medicine-chain dependent selects and connects research, production and marketing data and writes a coherent internal account. Its criteria do not require the whole prerequisite's separate audience-adaptation and source-reporting performance. Basic reading/structuring is necessary; the complete communication competence is not established as necessary.

Both feedstock cases require finding usable sources, recording author/date/claim, extracting comparable information for equal heat or packaging function and presenting a bounded decision. Selecting, structuring and citing question-relevant information is necessary to that actual research task.

The analgesic cases require opening specified primary information, recording the source location, interpreting chemical structures and historical population/denominator information, and making a bounded application claim. The prerequisite's source selection, interpretation and traceable reporting are necessary here.

Avogadro tasks state the ideal-gas model and ask conditional equality of gas volumes, particles and masses. One can justify these from that relation without explaining wall collisions, kinetic-energy changes or isothermal piston compression; a kinetic derivation is only one possible route.

The protection tasks require explaining passive barriers, damaged metal coatings, galvanic electron/ion paths and sacrificial-anode consumption. Local-element and sacrificial-anode mechanisms of the prerequisite are necessary to evaluate those protection options and their failure conditions.

Both angle-only cases explicitly give all molecule shapes and electron-domain arrangements and exclude renewed shape derivation. Deriving geometries from Lewis structures is therefore not necessary to assign the given reference angles and explain lone-pair deviations.

Washing tasks require micelles/dispersion, hardness precipitation and temperature/dose effects. The whole prerequisite also demands air/water interface orientation and explaining surface-tension reduction, which the current washing cases do not require. Micelles are a necessary subset, not the entire competence.

Tensid-class tasks classify given heads/chains/counterions and discuss hydration, protonation and pH. They do not need deriving micelles, emulsion structures or surface-tension reduction; those aggregate effects are subsequent applications of amphiphile structure.

The dependent uses the same NaCl melt and CuCl2 solution processes and requires ion migration, balanced electrode equations, product ratio and forced operation. The complete simple-salt electrolysis explanation is necessary; galvanic comparison adds a further operation.

Orbital-overlap cases supply H/Cl orbital occupations and the binding-energy model. Rutherford scattering interpretation, neutron/isotope counts and the full nuclear-shell evidential argument are not needed to explain overlap, paired electrons and an energy minimum.

The data-validity tasks can judge supplied controls, cross-reactivity and temperature confounding without producing their own trend diagram or relating measured trends to an initial investigation hypothesis. Those representation/hypothesis operations make the whole prerequisite broader than necessary.

The dependent's Hess justification and real calorimetry require an energy-conserving boundary, distinguishing heat exchange from stored energy and identifying gas-energy/work exchange. Its current explicit rigid/isobaric pV cases additionally require the qualitative piston-work and changed-boundary distinctions assessed by the full first-law prerequisite.

The product cases concern suitable primary and secondary alcohols and their aldehyde/ketone/acid products. The full prerequisite additionally requires comparing tertiary alcohols and explaining their lack of analogous mild oxidation; that separate boundary is not necessary to complete the current dependent cases.

Substitution cases supply C-halogen polarity and donor pairs and ask pair arrows/charge balance. Intermolecular dipole interactions, hydrogen bonding and boiling/solubility explanations are unnecessary to that intramolecular donor-acceptor mechanism.

Alcohol oxidation class depends on the OH-bearing carbon and its available hydrogen. Explaining hydrogen bonds, dipole-dipole forces and boiling or water-solubility trends is not necessary to classify oxidation under the stated common mild conditions.

EPA cases provide Lewis structures and ask electron-domain/shape inference. Interconverting multiple formula types and choosing a representation for a communication purpose is not required when the needed representation is already supplied.

The organic-class tasks already give complete condensed structures and functional-group information. Identifying those groups and rejecting a disjoint four-class scheme does not require producing alternative formula representations or choosing among representations.

Polarity cases already supply linear CO2 and bent water including 180/104.5 degree data. Vector cancellation/noncancellation needs the given geometry, not deriving ideal EPA angles, explaining lone-pair compression or distinguishing predicted angle from measurement.

Rutherford/isotope tasks can infer a concentrated charged nucleus and count p,n,e from given evidence and Z/A/charge. Explaining Dalton's historical assumptions and the law/hypothesis/model distinction is not necessary to perform those inferences.

Bond-energy cases provide equations, bond inventories and relative energy budgets. Qualitative energy balance does not require reconstructing Dalton's hypothesis or its isotope limitations and epistemic distinction from a law.

Recycling tasks require distinguishing retained chains from PET hydrolysis and using mass/energy flows. Full nucleophile-electrophile polymer synthesis with end-group-correct polyester/polyamide equations, finite linkage counts and HCl versus water elimination is not necessary to explain cleavage of a supplied ester linkage.

Actual selection and safe execution of isolation plus ASS synthesis/cleaning require understanding the substance-specific hazard information, including the meaning and limits of a pictogram and associated warning. Guessing a missing warning would not constitute safe performance; program qualification remains separate.

Validity cases assess already supplied records, controls and matrix/temperature confounds. Generating an original versioned protocol and recording later independent events/calculation corrections is not required to judge the evidence; identifying provenance is only a subset of full documentation production.

The isolation profile expressly requires its own unaltered masses, branches, solutions, times, temperatures, observations and calculations, separating own actions from teaching data. Traceable source/condition/unit documentation and separation of observation from interpretation are necessary to that whole practical result.

The enthalpy-comparison tasks use pre-evaluated bond-break/bond-formation budgets and require qualitative net direction, relative energy levels and the model boundary. These directly require the full qualitative bond-energy balance competence without imposing a new sum-calculation task.

The halogenated-hydrocarbon tasks require accessible source research and a labelled quotation. They do not require both analogue AND digital research or interpreting complex equilibrium/resource-balance representations, which are obligatory in the full prerequisite.

The advanced fuel-cell cases require independently writing acidic electrode and net reactions, explaining separate proton/electron paths and a blocked proton route, before comparison with alkaline operation and supply limits. The simpler H2/O2 fuel-cell conversion and stored-carrier competence is necessary to this performance.

The polarity tasks give EN, shapes and charge/density legends. Unequal shared-electron attraction and dipole cancellation can be explained without an orbital-overlap model, spin pairing or an energy-versus-distance minimum.

Oxidation-number cases give the acidic medium and structures. Deriving formal oxidation numbers and balancing electron transfer needs no colour-indicator classification or grober pH-range assignment; acidic conditions may be taken from the stated data.

Dalton tasks provide water composition and an atom-redistribution model, then distinguish observation/law/hypothesis and isotope limits. Recognising constant CuO/FeS elemental ratios and excess reactants is a possible historical motivation, not a necessary prior competence for these tasks.

Empirical formula and relative-mass inferences from elemental masses require treating a specified pure binary compound as having a fixed elemental mass ratio while separating compound composition from unused material. That is the constant-composition competence; gas-density information adds molecular-size discrimination.

Classifying supplied polymer chain/network structures and applications needs no halogenation chain mechanism, radicals, propagation or termination. Radical substitution is also chemically distinct from radical addition polymerisation; it cannot be required merely because both use radicals.

The Lewis/mesomerism tasks supply valence-electron totals and atom frameworks. Box-orbital occupations of isolated atoms/atomic ions and Hund/Pauli corrections are not needed to allocate the given electrons to molecular Lewis structures and resonance forms.

The quantum/PSE tasks require occupations, Hund/Pauli and orbital capacities but no atom-ion Lewis valence symbols or switching to that notation. Only the orbital component overlaps; the combined orbital-and-valence-symbol prerequisite is broader than necessary.

Independently writing and checking balanced equations requires interpreting element symbols and molecular formulas, counting atoms and distinguishing indices from coefficients. Those are the prerequisite's whole symbolic operations; without them coefficient adjustment could silently change substance identity.

The Brønsted tasks must form and check new protolysis equations, identify one-proton differences and preserve atom/charge counts. Correct symbols and simple molecular-formula formation/interpretation are necessary to write these equations rather than confuse proton transfer with electron or substance changes.

The dependent requires actual controlled Fehling/Benedict performance with real volumes, times, temperature, positive/negative controls and observed results interpreted against structural predictions. Safe guided execution, honest own records and explaining how the investigation tests its stated proposition are necessary.

Actual Ninhydrin/Biuret work requires following an approved method, separate controls, documenting real actions/results and interpreting what these do and do not support. Those are the guided-investigation competence; a written proline reference case alone cannot supply the dependent's execution.

The food panel requires actual safe controlled test procedures, separate own observation logs and interpretation of positive/negative controls and limits. These are necessary guided-investigation operations, independent of which nutrient branch supplies the current source anchor.

The isolation/ASS tasks require actual controlled safe execution, own raw observations and methodological controls that test identity/purity claims. The guided-investigation competence is necessary before those more demanding independent practical operations; BcP remains a separate program.

Choosing and actually executing suitable isolation/cleaning and ASS procedures safely requires identifying the concrete exposure pathways and choosing measures that reduce them. The risk-evaluation competence is necessary to that whole practical performance; it is not supplied by synthetic logs.

The secondary-cell tasks explain forced charging versus voluntary discharging, reconstruct reactions and assess energy for a real purpose under bounded conditions. Understanding reversible operation, distinct energy directions and why a device-empty or nonrechargeable battery is not automatically rechargeable is necessary to that stated secondary-cell function and use boundary.

Digestive-fluid tasks are qualitative explanations of acid/pepsin, bile emulsification and enzyme-specific pH conditions. They need no numeric strong-acid/base pH calculation, preparation of a defined solution or actual calibrated pH measurement, all required by the prerequisite.

Sublevel tasks give configurations and use first-ionisation anomalies and spectral lines. They do not require independently assigning shell configurations or interpreting successive-ionisation jumps to identify inner shells; that full simpler-Bohr task is one learning route, not a necessity of the supplied-data interpretation.

PSE cases read Z, period, group and valence count directly from a supplied table. Interpreting successive ionisation-energy jumps as experimental evidence is not needed; only a narrower shell-count convention overlaps.

Element/compound/mixture cases use explicit particle cards and atomic species/bonding. Creating a macroscopic property table, sorting by magnetism/density/solubility and limiting single-property identification is not required for those particle classifications.

Successful filtration, distillation and extraction choice must identify and compare the relevant phase, particle-size, volatility and solvent-specific solubility properties, and explain why one property alone does not establish identity or purity. Those are the generic property-description/classification operations, applied to separation.

Brønsted cases ask formal proton-transfer roles and equations and explicitly decline pH/equilibrium-amount inference. Relative H3O+/OH− population classification, neutral-temperature/activity boundaries and numerical ratio interpretation are not necessary to that formal task; only acid-particle versus solution distinction overlaps.

The proton-pump cases explain acid secretion, H+/K+ transport, inhibitor mechanism and supplied model pH quantities. They do not require explaining bile, emulsification, hydrolysis or digestive-enzyme conditions. This intermediate edge cannot propagate the broad digestive-fluid prerequisite to the drug endpoint.

The quantitative-food cases select and evaluate supplied calibration/titration data, with no required own execution. The prerequisite's experiment-and-calculation determination of a pure component and method-reliability performance is broader; meaningful selection/calculation alone does not require prior completion of its whole experimental competence.
